name: kaga-ult-build
description: Kaga's master build system for premium client websites. Orchestrates a nine-agent crew (art direction, UX, frontend, motion, backend, content/SEO, security, UAT, integration) through Plan then Act then Audit then Launch. Routes every phase to the installed specialist skills (modern-web-design, GSAP, Framer Motion, R3F, accessibility-review, security-review, ux-copy, deploy-checklist) rather than reimplementing them. Enforces a mandatory 10-site reference hunt, researched colour palettes and typography, a resolved image plan, zero framework defaults, baked-in security review, and a costed client quote. Use for any new site, redesign, landing page, or major visual feature that must look like a $10k+ agency build.
